space.name: env_layout_17
space.notes: T-K part 1's room with an A/C switch between two shelves (Hadi's design, 3 October 2026): env_layout_15 plus ac_switch_0 at (0, -480) on the south wall, between shelf_1 and shelf_4; every other object as in env_layout_15. For the tests of context knowledge on kitting, in the IRB (idle robot) and the MPB (working robot). Square, 1000 x 1000. Bearings are seen from kitting_table_0's centre (degrees, x east, y north), distances between centres. kitting_table_0 in the middle of the north wall at (0, 450), against it; five targets fan out from it to the south-west, south and south-east: shelf_3 (-450, -5), -134.7 deg, 640 cm; shelf_1 (-155, -450), -99.8 deg, 913 cm; shelf_4 (150, -450), -80.5 deg, 912 cm; coffee_machine_0 (475, -275), -56.8 deg, 867 cm; shelf_2 (445, 150), -34.0 deg, 537 cm. ac_switch_0, -90.0 deg, 930 cm, straight south of the table. corner_NE (450, 450) the one landmark, the exit walk's target; one A/C switch (the V1 rule, T-K AM18); no door, no obstacles. Not designed to produce a recognizer result. Stated consequences: as in env_layout_15, the fan spans 100.7 deg; the walks from the table are 537 to 930 cm; no walk from the table passes within 60 cm of another object's footprint; the coffee machine's neighbours by bearing are shelf_2 (22.8 deg) and shelf_4 (23.8 deg); the A/C switch's bearing is 9.5 deg from shelf_4's and 9.8 deg from shelf_1's, its centre 153 cm from shelf_4's and 158 cm from shelf_1's, so a walk from the table to the A/C switch and a walk to either shelf differ by under 10 deg in heading, against 22.8 to 34.9 deg between the other neighbours; corner_NE's bearing (0.0 deg, along the north wall) is 34.0 deg from shelf_2's.

Landmark (T-C1): the exit walk's target; a place for the human's script only; no task binds it. 50 cm in from both walls. From kitting_table_0 its bearing (0.0 deg, along the north wall) is 34.0 deg from the nearest target's (shelf_2); (450, -450) would be 6.6 deg from the coffee machine's. From the coffee machine the walk here passes through shelf_2's footprint, from shelf_4 27 cm from it.
